sections.title: The letters ph
paragraphs: The letters ph make the sound heard in (photo) /foʊ.toʊ/, which means an image. This letter pair makes two sounds in English. Most words use the first sound. Only a very few special names use the other sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your upper front teeth gently with your bottom lip. Blow air smoothly through the narrow gap. The first sound is voiceless. A voiceless sound is a sound where the voice is off. Your throat does not shake. For the second sound, turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it buzz.

sections.title: When to use each
paragraphs: The letters ph usually make the sound you hear in (phone) /foʊn/. You find this in most words from Greek origin, like (dolphin) /dɑl.fɪn/. The letters ph make the sound in (Stephen) /sti.vən/ only in that name.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not read each letter separately as two sounds. Do not push both lips together like the first sound in pot. Keep your top teeth firmly against your lower lip to let the air pass.
